# DUT Serial Console (Moxa MDS-G4000-L3-4XGS)

This skill lets you (Claude) run shell commands on the device under test
connected to /dev/ttyS0 — without an interactive TUI.

## Prerequisites (one-time setup the user must run)

The skill talks to /dev/ttyS0 directly via `picocom`. The current user
needs the `dialout` group:

```bash
sudo usermod -aG dialout $USER
# log out + log back in, OR run `newgrp dialout` in the current shell
```

If you (Claude) call `run.sh` and the user hasn't done this yet, the
script will exit with a clear instruction. Tell the user the command,
do not try to `sudo` your way around it.

## How to invoke

```bash
bash ~/.claude/skills/dut-console/run.sh "<cmd1>" "<cmd2>" ...
```

Each command is a positional argument. Examples:

```bash
# Single command
bash ~/.claude/skills/dut-console/run.sh "uname -a"

# Multiple — passed in order, prompt-synced between
bash ~/.claude/skills/dut-console/run.sh \
  "ip -br link" \
  "cat /etc/moxa/netsnmp/agentx_owned.list" \
  "snmpwalk -v2c -c public localhost ifTable | head -20"
```

The wrapper:

1. Spawns `picocom -b 115200 --noinit --noreset /dev/ttyS0`
2. Wakes the console (sends `\r`) and detects current state:
   - `login:`        → sends `admin` + `moxa`
   - `$` prompt      → Linux shell as non-root → sends `su` + `moxa`
   - `#` prompt      → already root (Linux) or ISS privileged → continue
   - `>` prompt      → ISS CLI mode → continue
3. Sends each command, waits for the next prompt
4. Exits picocom cleanly with `C-a C-x`
5. Captures **all** console I/O (including login, password echo, prompts)
   to `~/console_<YYYYMMDD>_<HHMMSS>.log`
6. Prints the log path on stdout

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Success — all commands sent, picocom exited cleanly |
| 1 | Bad args / no /dev/ttyS0 access |
| 2 | Login failed (wrong creds or unreachable login prompt) |
| 3 | Could not detect any prompt (device may be off/booting) |
| 4 | `su` failed (wrong password) |
| 5 | Timeout |

## Tuning

Default expect timeout is 15 s per response. For long-running commands
(firmware update, large snmpwalk on slow MIB), edit `set timeout` near
the top of `drive.exp`, OR pre-redirect the slow command into the
background and tail it on subsequent invocations.

## What this skill is NOT for

- Interactive debugging that needs you to read intermediate output and
  decide next commands mid-session — this is fire-and-forget per call.
- Anything that reboots the DUT mid-session (picocom drops on carrier
  loss; subsequent commands will be lost).
- Human-driven console use — the user's existing `mmmmminicom` alias
  (= `sudo minicom -D /dev/ttyS0`) is the right tool for that.

## When to use

Use this skill **without asking** when the user asks you to:
- "Run `<cmd>` on the device"
- "Check `<thing>` on the DUT"
- "Verify the new image actually works"
- "snmpwalk the device"
- "Show me what's in `<file>` on the switch"

Always tell the user the log path you got back so they can inspect it.

name: project_agentx_priority_direction_inverted
description: framework AgentX priority=200 LOSES to in-master 127 (smaller wins) — dual-reg GET never reaches framework; Plan E's GET/SET split can't work via priority
metadata:

**AgentX priority: smaller number wins.** RFC 2741 §6.2.3: "smaller values of
r.priority take precedence over larger values", default 127. net-snmp implements
this at `agent_registry.c:889` (`next->priority < new_sub->priority` orders the
children chain; the head serves requests).

- framework registers **200** — `lib_moxa_snmp_agentx/src/agentx.c:99/158/176`
  (comment there says "GET-serving sibling; SET stays in-master" — the intent is
  backwards from what 200 actually does).
- in-master registers **127** — `agent_handler.c:191`
  `the_reg->priority = DEFAULT_MIB_PRIORITY` (=127, `agent_registry.h:91`);
  `MOX_SNMP_INIT_ENTRY` → `netsnmp_register_handler` sets no custom priority.
  (This closes the handoff's "in-master=127 只是註解說法" unverified item.)

→ **For the 3 dual-reg groups whose in-master `MOX_SNMP_INIT_ENTRY` is still
active (mxSysTrustAccess / mxTrap / mxIpIfdb), in-master wins and framework's
IterTable handlers are dead code at runtime.** mxTurboRingV2 works only because
its INIT_ENTRY is commented out (`ies_auto_mibs_setup.c:377`).

Measured 2026-07-30, BUILD_TIME `2026_0730_1302`, DUT 192.168.127.253:
single `snmpget` → framework AgentX session packet count
`.603.3.4.1.2.1.1.1` **7** (control) / `.602.1.4.1.2.1.2.1` **0** / `.605.1.1.1.1.1.1.1` **0**.
Root-causes [[project_mxipif_col2_inmaster_deferred]] (col2 `0/0` = in-master
`atoi("vlanN")`) and answers T6 in the handoff.

**Why:** the whole ADR-0007/0008 detour started from an mxIpIf symptom that this
explains; and Plan E's "GET→framework / SET→in-master" cannot be implemented by
dual registration + priority at all — one region has exactly one winner and that
winner receives **every** PDU type (GET/GETNEXT/SET). Splitting by PDU type needs
either distinct OID regions or framework handling SET (rowStatus createAndGo/
destroy) itself.

**How to apply:** never infer AgentX ownership from walk-level packet counts — a
walk always consults the neighbouring registrant once at the region boundary
(observed floor ≈6 packets even for empty columns). Attribute with a **single
`snmpget` of one exact instance** against an idle baseline (framework's session
is silent when unqueried: 0 packets/6s; ISS's session pings ~3/6s). Identify
sessions by TCP source port from `ss -antp | grep :705`.
See [[project_snmp_walk_slow_diagnosis]], [[project_plan_e_iss0_get_forward]].

## T6 已結案 — 答案是「否」,且找到根因

**dual-reg group 的 GET 沒有進 framework,一個封包都沒有。**

### 量測(DUT `192.168.127.253`,BUILD_TIME `2026_0730_1302`)

session 靠 TCP port 區分:framework = `app_moxa_framew` pid 924 `:38870`,ISS = `ISS.exe` pid 298 `:38856`,master `snmpd` pid 982 listen `127.0.0.1:705`。**閒置 6s 基準線:framework session 0 封包**(ISS 有 ~3 個 keepalive)→ 任何 fw 封包都可歸因。

單一 instance `snmpget`(無 walk 邊界效應):

| GET | fw 封包 | 值 |
|---|---|---|
| `.603.3.4.1.2.1.1.1`(TR2,對照組) | **7** | INTEGER: 1 |
| `.602.1.4.1.2.1.2.1`(trustedIp col2) | **0** | IpAddress: 192.168.127.209 |
| `.605.1.1.1.1.1.1.1`(mxIpIf col1) | **0** | INTEGER: 1 |

⚠️ **walk 層級的封包數會騙人**:walk `.602.1.4.1.2` 看到 fw=12、`.602.7.2.1.3` fw=14,一度看起來像「framework 有在服務」。但那是 walk 走到 region 邊界時對鄰居註冊者的一次諮詢 —— mxIpIf 空欄 col2~col8 每欄都有 **6 個封包的地板值**,證明那與有沒有資料無關。**歸屬只能用單一 instance GET 判定。**

### 根因:priority 方向搞反了

- RFC 2741 §6.2.3(`~/WORK/SNMP_50ms/rfc2741.txt.pdf` 第 1505 行):**"smaller values of r.priority take precedence over larger values"**,預設 127。net-snmp 實作在 `agent_registry.c:889`。
- framework 註冊 **200** — `lib_moxa_snmp_agentx/src/agentx.c:99/158/176`,註解寫「GET-serving sibling; SET stays in-master」,但 200 的效果正好相反。
- in-master 註冊 **127** — `agent_handler.c:191` `the_reg->priority = DEFAULT_MIB_PRIORITY`;`MOX_SNMP_INIT_ENTRY` → `netsnmp_register_handler` 沒設自訂值。**這也把 handoff 未驗證項 #1(「in-master=127 只是註解說法」)關掉了,現在是原始碼證據。**

→ in-master `INIT_ENTRY` 仍 active 的三個 group(`ies_auto_mibs_setup.c:352/357/477` = mxSysTrustAccess / mxTrap / mxIpIfdb)**全部由 in-master 贏**,framework 的 `l3vlanif_iter_handler` 等 IterTable handler 是**執行期死碼**。mxTurboRingV2 之所以會動,只因為它的 INIT_ENTRY 被註解掉(`:377`)—— 沒有競爭者,不是 priority 贏。

### 要你決定的架構問題

同一個 region **只有一個贏家,而贏家收下所有 PDU type(GET/GETNEXT/SET)**。所以 Plan E 的「GET 走 framework、SET 留 in-master」**沒辦法用 dual registration + priority 實作**:

- 把 200 調小到贏 → framework 連 **SET 也一起拿走**,`mxTrap` / `trustAccess` / `mxIpIf` 的 rowStatus `createAndGo`/`destroy` 就會被 framework 攔下失效(正是 handoff §3 擔心的事,只是方向相反 —— 現在是「還沒贏」而不是「贏了要小心」)。
- 維持現狀 → 那三個 group 的 framework 端程式碼永遠不會被呼叫。

可行路徑只有兩條:**(a)** 按 OID region 切開(framework 只註冊唯讀欄/子樹,SET 欄留給 in-master),或 **(b)** framework 贏下整個 region 並自己實作 SET 轉 config layer(= Plan C 對 ISS 那條路)。這是設計決策,我沒有動任何 code。

### 兩點誠實交代

1. **`mxTrap` host table 是空的**(`.602.7.2.1.3` 回 `No Such Object`,沒有設 trap host),所以它的 GET 歸屬**沒有直接量到**,是由「in-master INIT_ENTRY active + 同樣 priority 200」推論而來。要實測需要在 DUT 上設一個 trap host —— 那會改 DUT 設定,你要的話我再做。
2. **我改了你的 `dut-console` skill**(`~/.claude/skills/dut-console/drive.exp`),兩處都是它在這台機器上必然失敗的 bug:
   - **root 判定**:這台 DUT 當 root 時提示符仍是 `$ `(log 裡那個反白 `#` 是 zsh 的 partial-line marker,不是提示符),而且已經是 root 時 `su` 根本不會問密碼 → 原本的 `-re {# }` 必定 timeout。改成用 `echo RC$(id -u)END` 判 uid。
   - **fence 撞自己的回音**:原本送 `; echo __CONSOLE_FENCE__`,shell 會把命令行回音出來,expect 就先match到回音才return → 每個命令的輸出都跑到下一個命令的標題下,**最後一個命令的輸出直接遺失**(我第一次的 8 欄量測就是這樣整段消失)。改送 `__CONSOLE""_FENCE__`、比對 `__CONSOLE_FENCE__`。
